question: Should OpenClaw adopt the lane/actor-oriented plugin channel API from this draft now, and if so should it land as a staged additive SDK migration or be split into narrower channel fixes first?
rationale: The PR changes public plugin SDK contracts and declares a non-backward-compatible migration, so the permanent API direction and migration window need maintainer intent beyond mechanical repair.

options.title: Refresh And Stage The API
options.body: Keep the lane/actor direction but rebase onto current main, fix the three correctness blockers, preserve old helper compatibility during a documented migration window, and require focused upgrade tests plus live channel proof before merge.

options.title: Split Channel Fixes First
options.body: Land only narrow channel projection or Teams routing fixes that match current MessagePresentation contracts, then revisit the cross-channel SDK API separately.

options.title: Pause The Draft
options.body: Leave the draft open but do not advance it until maintainers settle the public plugin channel contract and compatibility policy.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Stage The API
recommendation.body: Keep the lane/actor direction but rebase onto current main, fix the three correctness blockers, preserve old helper compatibility during a documented migration window, and require focused upgrade tests plus live channel proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: huntharo authored the branch and has the clearest context for the intended lane-oriented API shape.
